test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

He said that this had been in the box.

options.text: He said, "This was in the box."
He said, "This had in the box."
He said, "That have in the box."
He said that, "It is in the box."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that this had been in the box.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"this had been" becomes "This was"**
 
 
• The past perfect tense "had been" is converted to the past tense "was" in direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "this" remains unchanged as the same object is being referred to.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He said that"
 
• Converted to: "He said," maintaining the structure for reported speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "This" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“This was in the box,” he said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "He said, 'This had in the box.'" 

 
 
• Grammatically incorrect: "had in the box" is incomplete and lacks the verb "been."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said, 'That have in the box.'" 
 
 
• Grammatically incorrect: "have" does not match the required tense and subject agreement.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said that, 'It is in the box.'" 
 
 
• Incorrect structure: "that" is unnecessary before the quoted speech in direct speech.
 
• Tense mismatch: "is" should be "was" to match the past context.
